title: AWS AI and ML Services
description: Managed AWS services for foundation models, ML, and AI application services.

cards.definition: Fully managed service providing access to foundation models from multiple providers through one API
Managed RAG capability that connects foundation models to your data sources
Managed capability for building agents that call APIs and use knowledge bases to complete tasks
Configurable safeguards that filter harmful content, block topics, and redact sensitive information
Tooling to compare and assess foundation model outputs using automatic or human evaluation
Reserved model capacity for consistent performance at a fixed hourly rate
Fully managed service to build, train, tune, and deploy ML models
Hub of pretrained models and solution templates within SageMaker
No-code visual interface for building ML models and generating predictions
Data labeling service combining human labelers and automated labeling
Tool to detect bias in data and models and explain predictions

example.text: Before launching a model that ranks job applicants, a staffing firm runs SageMaker Clarify on its training data and finds applicants over 50 are badly underrepresented. After rebalancing and retraining, the post-training bias metrics look acceptable, and Clarify's feature attributions show the model relies mostly on skills and experience, not graduation year. The firm hands the report to its compliance team.

cards.definition: Monitors deployed models for data quality and drift

example.text: A food-delivery company predicts delivery times from a live SageMaker endpoint. SageMaker Model Monitor compares the captured requests with a baseline built from the training data. When a new partner app starts sending distances in kilometers instead of miles, the data quality check reports violations, a CloudWatch alert fires, and the team fixes the feed before customers see wildly wrong arrival times.

cards.definition: Central repository for storing and sharing ML features
Tool for preparing and transforming data for ML
Service for automating ML workflows from data prep through deployment
Generative AI assistant that answers questions over your enterprise data
Generative AI assistant that helps with coding, debugging, and AWS tasks
NLP service for sentiment analysis, entity recognition, and topic modeling
Service for image and video analysis, such as object and face detection
Service that extracts text, forms, and tables from scanned documents
Speech-to-text service
Text-to-speech service
Neural machine translation service
Service for building conversational chatbots with voice and text
Intelligent enterprise search service using natural language queries
Service for building real-time recommendation systems
Service for time-series forecasting
Adds human review workflows to ML predictions when confidence is low

example.text: A city permit office uses Amazon Textract to read fields from scanned, often handwritten, building-permit applications. With Amazon A2I, any form where Textract has low confidence in a key field goes to a permit clerk, who checks the original and corrects the value. High-confidence forms go straight through, so staff spend their time only on the hard cases.

cards.definition: AWS custom chip optimized for training ML models
AWS custom chip optimized for running (inferring) ML models cost-effectively
